strongest_angle: Investigative analysis reveals that the Department of Justice holds 6 million pages of Epstein-related material, yet significant gaps in the document sequence suggest that classified information and emails were systematically withheld from public release.

key_facts.fact: The Department of Justice collected 6 million pages of material related to Jeffrey Epstein and released over 3 million pages after internal reviews.
Internal documents indicate that at least three files identified as classified were included in the collection, including an FBI document.
A GitHub analysis of the EFTA document sequence shows that only 376,571 distinct documents exist out of a potential range spanning over 2.7 million slots.
The Office of the Deputy Attorney General received classified material related to Jeffrey Epstein in March 2025.
